# frozen_string_literal: true
# K8s Network Proxy - File Cache Module
# Handles upstream response caching for the proxy layer

require 'sinatra'
require 'securerandom'
require 'fileutils'
require 'digest'
require 'json'
require 'uri'
require 'base64'
require 'rack/utils'

module ProxyCache
  CACHE_ROOT = ENV.fetch('CACHE_DIR', '/var/cache/proxy')
  MAX_CACHE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024 # 50MB
  ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES = %w[
    application/octet-stream
    application/json
    text/html
    text/plain
    image/png
    image/jpeg
  ].freeze

  class CacheEntry
    attr_reader :key, :metadata, :created_at

    def initialize(key, metadata = {})
      @key = key
      @metadata = metadata
      @created_at = Time.now.utc
    end

    def cache_path
      subdir = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(@key)[0..7]
      File.join(CACHE_ROOT, subdir, safe_filename)
    end

    private

    def safe_filename
      # Extract filename from the cache key (URL path)
      basename = File.basename(URI.parse(@key).path)
      # Sanitize: only allow alphanumeric, dots, hyphens, underscores
      sanitized = basename.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/, '_')
      sanitized.empty? ? 'cached_response' : sanitized
    end
  end
end

class ProxyApp < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :bind, '0.0.0.0'
    set :port, ENV.fetch('PROXY_PORT', 8080)
    set :environment, :production
    enable :logging
  end

  helpers do
    def validate_content_type(content_type)
      return false if content_type.nil?
      base_type = content_type.split(';').first.strip.downcase
      ProxyCache::ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES.include?(base_type)
    end

    def validate_cache_size(size)
      size.to_i > 0 && size.to_i <= ProxyCache::MAX_CACHE_SIZE
    end

    def authenticate_request
      token = request.env['HTTP_X_PROXY_TOKEN']
      expected = ENV.fetch('PROXY_AUTH_TOKEN', nil)
      return true if expected.nil? # Auth disabled if no token configured
      # Use a constant-time comparison to avoid timing attacks on the token
      unless token && Rack::Utils.secure_compare(token.to_s, expected.to_s)
        halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json
      end
    end

    def resolve_cache_path(entry, extension_hint)
      base_path = entry.cache_path
      # Apply extension from Content-Type if the cached file lacks one
      if extension_hint && !File.extname(base_path).empty?
        base_path
      else
        apply_extension(base_path, extension_hint)
      end
    end

    def apply_extension(path, content_type)
      ext_map = {
        'application/json' => '.json',
        'text/html' => '.html',
        'text/plain' => '.txt',
        'image/png' => '.png',
        'image/jpeg' => '.jpg',
        'application/octet-stream' => '.bin'
      }
      ext = ext_map.fetch(content_type, '.bin')
      "#{path}#{ext}"
    end

    def within_cache_root?(path)
      expanded = File.expand_path(path)
      expanded.start_with?(File.expand_path(ProxyCache::CACHE_ROOT))
    end
  end

  before do
    authenticate_request
    content_type 'application/json'
  end

  # Store upstream response in cache
  post '/cache/store' do
    payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read) rescue halt(400, { error: 'Invalid JSON' }.to_json)

    cache_url = payload['url']
    content = payload['content']
    ct = payload['content_type'] || 'application/octet-stream'
    filename_override = payload['filename']

    halt 400, { error: 'Missing url' }.to_json unless cache_url
    halt 400, { error: 'Missing content' }.to_json unless content
    halt 400, { error: 'Invalid content type' }.to_json unless validate_content_type(ct)

    decoded_content = Base64.decode64(content) rescue halt(400, { error: 'Invalid base64' }.to_json)
    halt 413, { error: 'Content too large' }.to_json unless validate_cache_size(decoded_content.bytesize)

    entry = ProxyCache::CacheEntry.new(cache_url)
    
    # Determine final storage path
    if filename_override
      # Admin-specified filename for organized caching
      final_path = compute_override_path(entry, filename_override, ct)
    else
      final_path = resolve_cache_path(entry, ct)
    end

    halt 403, { error: 'Path violation' }.to_json unless within_cache_root?(final_path)

    FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(final_path))
    File.open(final_path, 'wb') { |f| f.write(decoded_content) }

    status 201
    { stored: true, path: final_path, size: decoded_content.bytesize }.to_json
  end

  # Retrieve cached response
  get '/cache/fetch' do
    cache_url = params['url']
    halt 400, { error: 'Missing url' }.to_json unless cache_url

    entry = ProxyCache::CacheEntry.new(cache_url)
    ct = params['content_type'] || 'application/octet-stream'
    final_path = resolve_cache_path(entry, ct)

    halt 404, { error: 'Not found' }.to_json unless File.exist?(final_path)
    halt 403, { error: 'Path violation' }.to_json unless within_cache_root?(final_path)

    content_type ct
    send_file final_path
  end

  private

  def compute_override_path(entry, filename, content_type)
    # Sanitize the override filename
    clean_name = File.basename(filename).gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/, '_')
    # Use a random subdirectory to prevent any path prediction attacks
    subdir = SecureRandom.hex(16)
    base = File.join(ProxyCache::CACHE_ROOT, subdir, clean_name)
    # Ensure proper extension based on content type
    if File.extname(base).empty?
      apply_extension(base, content_type)
    else
      base
    end
  end
end

# Health check endpoint for K8s liveness probe
class HealthCheck < Sinatra::Base
  get '/healthz' do
    content_type 'application/json'
    { status: 'ok', cache_dir: ProxyCache::CACHE_ROOT }.to_json
  end
end

ProxyApp.run! if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
